description: Adds share entries (users and groups) to a DataModel.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the DataModel to add shares to.

shares.description: List of dictionaries containing share details. Each dictionary should have: - name: Name of the user or group - type: Type of the party (user or group) - permission: Permission level (EDIT, READ, USE)

description: Retrieves all share entries (users and groups) for a given DataModel in flat row format.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the DataModel to retrieve shares for.
